The verifier passes. The cube is seated in the tray slot and released.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Cube distance from slot centre | 0.49 mm (tolerance 3 mm) |
| Cube speed | 0 mm/s |
| Held by gripper | no |

**What I did**

- Opened the gripper and moved above the cube on the bed with a top-down pitch.
- Rolled the wrist so the jaws were square to the cube's faces, which sat at about 7 degrees of yaw.
- The first close at a higher height missed because the cube was too far below the gripper site. I lowered the tool centre point to 13 mm and the second close grasped it.
- Lifted, carried the cube over the slot, and rolled the wrist again so the cube's yaw matched the pocket.
- Read back the actual cube position before release and it was 1.5 mm from the slot centre, so I released it just above the funnel. It slid into the pocket.

The arm is still parked over the tray with the gripper open. I stopped there as requested, so it has not been sent home.
